definitions.native_decode: Native request statistic; seconds excludes prefill and rate counts tokens after the first token.
definitions.peak_aggregate: Difference of native scheduler decode counters over one observed 1.0-1.6 second window; not a sum of individual request rates.
definitions.batch_aggregate: Total branch completion tokens over shared batch generation wall time, including request prefill, streaming and receipts; excludes preflight and warm seed.
definitions.first_response: Proxy receipt of first reasoning/text/tool delta after complete HTTP request; visible answer text is separately reported.
definitions.comparison: Controlled 128K comparison and two separate agent demonstrations; agent contexts, thinking and concurrency differ and do not form a controlled comparison.
